|translation='''Title:''' Blast Door (protective door) control panel.

'''Card text:''' Deploy on your side of the table. May cancel the following cards: [[Into The Garbage Chute, Flyboy]]; [[Narrow Escape]]; [[Blast The Door, Kid!]]; and [[Rebel Barrier]].

'''Lore:''' A control panel used to close and lock blast doors in an emergency. Luke shot the panel from Hangar Bay 327 to delay the Imperial forces.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese card says the named cards can be canceled; the English says it cancels them. The Japanese lore says Luke shot the panel from Hangar Bay 327 to delay the Imperial forces; the English says he destroyed it, locking them out of the bay.
